messages:
Nina (AE): Quick from HelioBank POC — they need SOC 2 excerpt, ISO snippet focusing on EU data residency, and a signed pen-test letter. Also asking if we can allow a scoped unauthenticated scan for 30 minutes next Tue 09:00 CET. What do we need?
Ola (Solutions Eng): I can assemble SOC2+ISO excerpts and a simple EU dataflow diagram. Will point out that backups to EU region are documented.
Pri (Security): Unauth scan OK on staging only, must provide exact hostnames + IPs, UA, and confirm no KMS/HSM or admin endpoints in scope. We'll require a signed authorization letter from their side too.
Nina (AE): Helio lead: sec-contact@heliobank.eu. They provided IPs 3.121.45.90 and UA "HelioProbe/3.3". Hostnames: staging-eu.heliobank.eu. Window requested Tue 08:50 CET -> 09:20 CET.
Ben (Infra): We'll whitelist /32 CIDRs and schedule firewall open/close. Need estimator for expected request rate to avoid autoscale thrash.
Ola (Solutions Eng): Expected low rate (<15 r/s). I'll prepare package and presigned link. Also note: Helio asked if we can include an excerpt showing data-at-rest encryption in EU region.
Pri (Security): We'll redact any internal ticket references. Also confirm Helio will sign indemnity via their legal contact.
Nina (AE): Sending legal fields for pen-test template: signer_name: Lukas Weber; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: HelioBank AG; testing_scope: unauthenticated external scan of staging-eu.heliobank.eu only; desired_return_email: sec-contact@heliobank.eu
LegalBot: Received fields. Also require company registration number for EU attestation. Reply with that and we'll include our standard indemnity clause and return signed PDF within 48h after verification.
Nina (AE): Helio replies reg_no: CH-987654-1.
Ola (Solutions Eng): Uploaded SOC2 + ISO EU excerpt + dataflow diagram to presigned S3: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/helio/package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Ben (Infra): Scheduling firewall: open 3.121.45.90/32 at Tue 08:50 CET, close 09:25 CET. Adding alerting + rollback if traffic >100 r/s.
Pri (Security): I'll do quick review once upload is live and mark redactions. LegalBot, pls confirm when PDF is signed and we can share.
LegalBot: Drafting signed pen-test letter; will return signed PDF within 48 hours after internal review.
Nina (AE): Thanks team — passing to Helio: sec-contact@heliobank.eu. Will update with signed attestation. :white_check_mark:
